items.headline: Albemarle (ALB) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Turn More Cautious
items.snippet: Truist and Argus highlight Albemarle cost efficiencies, capital discipline and efforts to reduce costs and conserve cash, which they see as support for free cash flow and balance sheet strength.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in electric vehicles and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its overall 2026 outlook, expecting to perform at the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: [US Feature Stocks] Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle (ALB), the world's largest lithium supplier, reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership on the final day of negotiation talks ahead of a strike, the union announced.
